name: Summer All Day Program
description_short: A full-day summer program run by the Attleboro Recreation Department at the Bartek Recreation Center, 8:00am-5:00pm on weekdays. Activities include arts and crafts, a computer lab, daily swimming at Briggs Pool, indoor sports and up to 4 field trips.
activities: Field trips (bowling, zoo, laser tag, carnival)
special_needs_notes: Families who need ADA accommodations or program changes must submit an ADA Program Accommodation Request Form in time. A late form may delay or prevent participation.
swim_waterfront_notes: Daily open swim and swim lessons at the Briggs Pool. Children must bring a bathing suit and towel.

warnings: This page covers the 2026 season (June 29 - August 14, 2026), which has already ended as of 2026-10-13. Dates and prices for 2027 are not posted.

Pricing has several parts: $200/week for the 1st child, $170/week for each additional child, and a daily rate of $55. Children must enroll for at least six weeks and three days per week, so the total depends on the schedule chosen. The session price is left blank for that reason.
The phone number listed is the general Attleboro City Hall number, not a direct line for the Recreation Department.
Registration is on paper forms only. Payment is by check, money order or cash. Online registration and payment are not available.
Attleboro residents get to register first. Non-residents are considered only after residents have been registered.
